title: Human-committed evidence gate (docs/baseline/evidence.json)
description: The authoritative check is kitlib.evidence.check (.claude/scripts/kitlib/evidence.py): schema == evidence.v1, no template placeholders, at least 3 fixture_runs with clean == true and unique ids, a real_feature with an id and completed == true, a non-empty attested_by. This file documents the shape; extra properties are allowed.

clean.description: true only for a run with no control-flow rescues and no escaped defects

kill_criteria_checked.description: docs/baseline/kill-criteria.md was evaluated against the baseline and not tripped
